Which ads sent this week's 1,020 store clicks

Every Monday at 9 AM, Stride Run Club's click table posts last week's campaigns to the growth channel in Slack. The newsletter turned half of its 520 visitors into store clicks. The podcast ad sent 860 visitors and only 60 clicks, and its budget went to the newsletter.

fieldData.awb---integration-feature-1:
Saturday fills up with 12 requests

Saltmarsh Chiropractic opens from 8 am to noon on Saturdays and offers 12 first-visit slots. The form shows how many are left, and a visitor who sees Saturday running low can pick a weekday. This week 9 slots are taken and 3 remain. Once the twelfth request arrives, Saturday drops off the list of days on the form.
